title: Kinetix+
description: An smp plugin which adds orgins, combat based currency, and quality of life additions. Originally known as UltimateSMP, but dropped for a more original name.
body:
# PLEASE READ THIS!

## About
KinetixQOL is a mini-project I am working on which takes inspiration from many different plugins, mods and more and merges it into one easy to use 1.21.11 plugin.

Some features of this plugin:
1. Classes with powers
(The class's power scale with kill / death bound currency called memories such as power from Bliss SMPs. Powers are well balanced and tied to different thing as you keep reading. I also say race and class alot. They are the same.)

2. Custom crafting recipes which are fully customizable by admins
(Create your own recipes, change recipes, delete recipes, all in a easy UI in game.)

3. Shield Stuns built in


## Permissions and commands:

### Default:
/recipes -> brings up menu of all available custom crafts
/memories -> tells you how many memories you have
/memories <player username> -> tells you how many memories other players may have
/race -> tells you your class. IDK I was deciding between race or class for this so I change around alot.

### Vega:
/vtp <set | del | list | name of where you want to tp> -> Sets a teleport point, deletes a teleport point, lists all teleports, and teleports you to where you want to go

### Smuggler:
/stash -> Extra inventory

### Barterer:
/tradingpost -> Summons an unemployed villager

### Operator:
/race admin reset <username> -> resets a player's class

/race admin set <username> <class> -> sets a player's class

/memories set <player username> <number> -> sets a player's memories to a number

/changerecipe -> brings up the menu to change recipe

/cooldown reset -> resets cooldown for everybody

/stun <enable | disable> -> toggles stuns to be on or off


## Classes:
Players on first join or when they craft "Synthetic Memories" are able to choose a class. The class GUI has all available classes as well as a random button. 
I don't know where else to put this but Memories are currency which are dropped on death by players. Capped at -10 and 10 inclusive. If a player is at -10 they cannot drop any Memories. If a player is at 10, they cannot pick up Memories. Synthetic Memories and Memories have different properties. Synthetic Memories allow you to give yourself +1 Memory or change your class.

Human -> No powers but HP, armor, and damage scale with the amount of memories you have.
(Inspired by my laziness. But mostly from general SMPs like Lifesteal, and Strength.)

Wraith -> A power gem which power scales with memories. When you hit -10, don't use your gem or you will become human.
(Core mechanic of blinding enemies is inspired from a Roblox game which is currently shut down.)

Vega -> You can set teleports and tp back to them. If you have less than 0 memories, you will always random tp on /vtp. Cast time changes with memories. 
(Inspired from home plugins. But I think homes are too op.)

Smuggler -> Extra inventory which you drop on death. Scales with memories you have.
(Inspired from Ranked SMP)

Avian -> You get a limited durability elytra and an end rod which has 2 modes. Power of end rod and durability of elytra scales with memories.
(Inspired from Orgin's Avian)

Dedicated -> General buffs to farming and food related things.
(Idk just needed a kinda "healer" class)

Barterer -> Ability to summon a villager, and infinite hero of the village.
(I wanted to create a class dedicated to the base wives)

Vampire -> Health related abilities. Deal more damge, heal more, but some annoying debuffs.
(I was thinking of Hypixel Skyblock's rift the other day)

Monk -> Secret (op) class!
Hint: You need to be very low on memories as a human and vanquish a high memory enemy of a certain class. You will lose this class if you die.

Apothecary -> Secret (kinda op) class! Might be buffed in the future.
Hint: Advancement based quest which requires you to be a dedicated.

## More Info / Updates
More classes coming soon. Also the additions of general QOL SMP mechanics will be added.
Most recent release is 1.0-RELEASE. In version 2.0-RELEASE I plan to have:
1. Default ezgaps, ezanivl, and ezcobs (You can already do this, but its not default)

## Future Additions
1. More default custom crafts
2. Bosses
3. More classes

I wanted this to have more, but then I realized that other than shields and stuns being built in and custom crafts so people don't need to install ezgaps or ezcobs or ezanvil or anything, they have no use for any other plugins. Of course, I won't be adding any performance QOL for this. Other than this, everything else is too niche.

Formerly known as UltimateSMP, so certain files may still be under this name.


If you have any questions or bug reports, fill out this google form:
